body.overview:
Clayox helps early childhood education centres run admissions, attendance, daily care updates, family messaging, and invoice-first billing from one platform. Each centre gets a dedicated deployment so operations stay organised without juggling spreadsheets and disconnected tools.

For the complete product experience, visit Clayox childcare management software. That is the primary Clayox website. This IGENTX page is only a concise summary for people exploring our products.

Prices in USD. Clayox software alone starts at $240/year ($20/mo equivalent) for 20 students. A website, AI enquiry assistant (Starter and up), email, and SEO are available through the IGENTX Childcare Digital Partnership (software-side details also on clayox.com/digital-partnership). The Clayox interface is English, with AI message translation into 100+ languages including Arabic. Billing supports AED and VAT.

Clayox is a progressive web app today, not a native mobile app, and there is no online payment gateway yet. To walk through Clayox or a partnership plan, book a Clayox demo or talk to IGENTX.
